scene: The clock mechanism chimes, swinging open transit gates across the bustling plaza.
picture: Pixel art wide side view of Clocktower Square under drizzle. On the far left, a docked harbour ferry idles. Left of centre, the player stands beside the now-open grandfather clock with her red umbrella. Up high, an orange cable car cabin hangs ready. On the far right, stairs descend into a lit subway station.
shown: a striped harbour ferry moored at a canal dock on the far left
an orange cable car cabin waiting suspended on cables up high
